bias.reason: Friday's pivot is 7210–20: Thursday's big intraday low area, with the biggest SPX gamma level for Friday's expiry, 7200, at about ES 7219. Thursday gapped up and failed: ES made an overnight high of 7440.5, opened 7411.5, topped 7436.5 at 6:34 AM PT, lost 7373 by 7:15 AM PT and 7305 by 7:37 AM PT, then sold to 7192 at 12:05 PM PT. Close 7194.25 at 12:59 PM PT (SPX 7175.84, −2.02%; SPY 715.87, −1.96%; QQQ 645.04, −2.19%; VIX 28.48, +15.9%). The S&P 500 fell for a sixth day. After hours ES traded 7167.75–7201, last 7182.50 at 1:59 PM PT, below 7192 (Thursday's regular-session low). Price is under the pivot, so the structure stays bearish until 7210–20 is recovered; 7305–09 (the Tue/Wed shelf of lows) is the line that would hand control back to bulls. Recovering 7210–20 targets 7240–45, then 7269–77. Failing under 7210–20 targets 7192, then 7168, then 7136–16 (SPY 710–708 and the bottom of Friday's expected range). Every expiry is negative gamma and SPX closed just under its 7200 level, so moves can stretch both ways; VIX 28.48 sits on its 30 wall, and a VIX break above 30 favours the downside case. The unpadded plan band is 7167.75–7436.5 (Thursday's regular session 7192–7436.5 plus the after-hours low). Friday's SPX expected range is 7093.80–7257.88 (±1.14%), about ES 7113–7277. ES ≈ SPX + 19.1 from Thursday's regular-session median. Fed Waller 5:25 AM PT; Michigan sentiment 7:00 AM PT; Fed Cook 9:15 AM PT; monthly options expiration at the 1:00 PM PT close.
